description: What a coding / tool-using agent costs a month on each model: tasks a day, model calls per task, context tokens per call, answer and reasoning tokens per call, percent of the context read from the prompt cache - priced at the cheapest real-time seller of each model (default: 13 usual coding models), cheapest first, USD, 30 days, with each model's reasoning class. Rows have card_url and cite.

cache_pct.description: percent of context from the prompt cache, default 70

context.description: input tokens per call (the resent context), default 30000

models.description: model ids to compare; default the usual coding models

reasoning.description: reasoning tokens per call (billed as output), default 1500

name: agent_cost
